desc: Reduce the pattern to ordered nonempty literal blocks and handle the all-empty / one-block cases.
Implement a cached KMP occurrence finder for literal blocks in s.
Build next-start arrays for subsequent blocks using an INF sentinel over positions 0..n.
Compute the minimum non-overlapping span for k=1, k=2, and k=3 blocks, returning -1 when impossible.
Verify the provided samples and edge cases, and finalize the code in the starter format.
